about_the_game:
To And Fro

To And Fro is a vibrant VR action-adventure 3D platformer where you navigate a colorful world filled with challenges to overcome and pathways to discover.

Guide the hero Joe, a miniature man who could fit in the palm of your hand! He happily tends to life inside his lush terrarium, never suspecting that his vibrant world is only a clever illusion. To Joe, the painted walls are the edge of reality itself, but clues and evidence abound that there is something more. Join him on a spirited journey to uncover what lies beyond and help him find a way out.

A Miniature World, Full of Life

Immerse yourself in an atmospheric quest, featuring impressionistic, low-poly graphics reminiscent of the N64 era.

Discover the unparalleled depth and immersion that only VR can offer, allowing you to effortlessly gauge distance, dodge and fight enemies, maneuver around obstacles, and hop between platforms with pinpoint accuracy.

Throughout your adventure, collect and master eight unique power-up abilities that grant new ways to move, explore, and interact with the world. Each ability is integral to progressing through the environment and uncovering hidden pathways.

Play Your Way in VR

Experience To And Fro from a captivating third-person perspective, where you directly observe and influence your character.

Play either seated or standing, with full control of your viewpoint through precise, motion-tracked controller positioning.

Unlike a joystick limited to two-dimensional input, the tracked 3D position of the controller enables true three-axis movement, letting you physically shift your perspective in all directions anywhere around the world.

The VR perspective brings the world to life in a way that flat-screen 3D platformers simply cannot match, creating a fluid and intuitive way to view your character as you guide him through the adventure while enjoying a dynamic and immersive gameplay experience.

Dive into a world of adventure with To And Fro!
